plugin.name: StatusBarInset
plugin.description: Returns the real, on-device status bar inset height (dp) via WindowInsetsCompat, so JS-side layout code (e.g. AdMob banner offset) can match it exactly instead of guessing a fixed constant. Android only; no-op stub is not needed since JS callers should feature-detect (window.cordova.plugins && window.cordova.plugins.statusBarInset).
